Kavachi is an active submarine volcano that sits roughly 25m below the surface of the ocean. Located approximately 50 NM from Nggatokae island, Kavachi can sometimes form an island of fresh earth that typically is washed away by waves. Here, the volcano dramatically erupts. Photographed 2016-10-31.
